definitions.gloss: slim build; slender figure; thin physique
definitions.explanation: Describes a person or object that is thin and slender. When used about people, it refers to a naturally slim body type. When used about objects, it means narrow or slim in design.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{細身|ほそみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体型|たいけい}→体型：16561_taikei⟧だ。
{細身|ほそみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ジーンズ→ジーンズ：00123_jiinzu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧。
examples.english: Slim-fit jeans look good on you.

examples.japanese: {細身|ほそみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{格好良|かっこよ}く⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。

notes:
Composed of {細|ほそ} (thin, slender) + ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧ (body). Functions as both a noun and a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective: {細身|ほそみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～. Generally a neutral or positive descriptor, unlike words like ⟦{痩|や}せている→痩せる：01146_yaseru⟧ which can imply being too thin.
